text:
Rafi Gomez: noticing embed-service tail latency regressions on prod-apac since ~22:40 UTC. proposing hotfix deploy in the 22:50-23:00 UTC slot. can we do expedited approval?
Elena Park: what's the artifact and risk?
Rafi Gomez: v2.1.11-hotfix — fixes an iterator edge-case in kv eviction. CI green, small diff. impact limited to embed hot path.
Samir Das: QA can run quick smoke + perf in parallel, need ~5m. ops — can you accept a one-shot canary-skip for the squeeze window?
OpsBot: opsbot: canary-skip allowed for 10m window if QA signs off. rollback criteria: error-rate >0.7% OR 95p latency +250ms for 5m.
QA Bot: smoke done. basic perf checks pass. small warmup spike at ~90s, otherwise stable. :white_check_mark:
DeployBot: deploybot: queued rollout r-infer/embed-service v2.1.11-hotfix -> prod-apac (3 pods). canary=false (requested). run_id=deploy-6482739100. docs: https://internal/redwood/deploys/6482739100
Elena Park: applying pool pin: `trafficctl pin --pool apac-hotfix --service embed-service --version v2.1.11-hotfix --meta "expedite-6482739100"`
OpsBot: opsbot: pin applied, routing update to 2 edges confirmed.
DeployBot: deploybot: rollout started (0/3 ready). healthcheck path=/ready expected 200.
Rafi Gomez: monitoring hooks enabled. if any 502s >1% for 3m, rollback to v2.1.10 and unpin.
DeployBot: deploybot: rollout progress 3/3 ready. run_id=deploy-6482739100. live traffic routed.
QA Bot: 10m watch complete, no regressions observed. LGTM.
Elena Park: leaving pin for 1h for extra safety then auto-unpin. release-notes draft ready.
Rafi Gomez: thanks everyone — opening follow-up ticket for replication of warmup spike. closing thread. :checkered_flag:
